P_ext_1.statement: the split-half reliability of graded per-sentence support (fraction of readings that include a sentence, both judges pooled), Spearman-Brown-corrected to the full instrument, is >= 0.85 at 30 readings
P_ext_1.basis: reviewer's split-half r = 0.556 at n = 10 => Spearman-Brown full-10 reliability 0.714 => 3x length => 0.883. This module reproduces the reviewer's measurement at r = 0.5444 / SB 0.7050 (20 seeded draws), which projects to 0.877 at 30.
P_ext_1.estimator: per pair, over the union of the n readings' sentences, Pearson r between the two halves' support fractions, averaged over pairs; 20 random half-splits, seeded

P_ext_2.statement: the scout-only union of distinct evidence SENTENCES at k = 20 is within 10 % of the asymptote of a Michaelis-Menten fit to scout's k = 1..5 curve
P_ext_2.note: the fit's own arithmetic already says k = 20 reaches only 81.2 % of Vmax, so the prediction AS STATED is expected to FAIL unless the curve flattens faster than Michaelis-Menten. It is pre-registered as stated and scored as stated. The informative secondary is the projection's accuracy: |U(20)_observed - 58.7603| / 58.7603 <= 0.10.
